name: How do you ensure the new paint matches the existing paint in my home?

mainEntity.name: How do you ensure the new paint matches the existing paint in my home?

acceptedAnswer.text: To ensure the new paint in your addition seamlessly matches the existing paint in your home, we employ several techniques. We can use color-matching technology to accurately identify the exact shade and sheen of your current paint. Alternatively, we may suggest painting an entire connecting wall or section to create a natural break point, especially if the existing paint has faded over time. We'll discuss the best approach with you to achieve a cohesive look.
acceptedAnswer.description: We use color-matching technology or suggest painting connecting walls to ensure the new paint blends seamlessly with existing colors.
